calls.statement:
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units, count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT p.product_key) AS versions, min(f.quantity) AS minq, max(f.quantity) AS maxq
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 10

calls.statement:
WITH a AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date AS d, sum(f.quantity) AS u, sum(net_amount) AS n FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 1),
 b AS (SELECT business_date AS d, units_sold, net_sales_before_returns FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27')
SELECT coalesce(a.d,b.d) d, a.u, b.units_sold, a.n, b.net_sales_before_returns FROM a FULL JOIN b ON a.d=b.d
WHERE a.u IS DISTINCT FROM b.units_sold OR a.n IS DISTINCT FROM b.net_sales_before_returns ORDER BY 1
